Thompson posteriors disconnect from execution outcomes. coverage-tick template returns: total_executions=68, successful_executions=60, failed_executions=8 — but thompson_alpha=1 and thompson_beta=1 (uniform Beta(1,1) prior, unchanged from initialization). success_rate is reported as 0 despite the obvious 60/68=0.88 from the executions. evidence.excerpt: { total_executions: 68, successful_executions: 60, failed_executions: 8, success_rate: 0, thompson_alpha: 1, thompson_beta: 1, total_selections: 0 }

findings.operator_remediation: This is a structural finding about the learning loop itself. The Thompson posterior update path (validator wrote earlier about Phase 18.4 chain-credit) appears to not be writing to the variant_performance_metrics keyed under the template_id this endpoint reads from. Either (a) the per-template metrics are coming from a counter table that doesn't connect to variant_performance_metrics, (b) the writes are going elsewhere, or (c) the writes succeeded but the API serializes posteriors with a default value instead of the actual values. Worth dev investigation — without this loop closing, the substrate cannot improve from its observed executions, regardless of how many template invocations succeed.
